description: This file defines a static class 'ServiceLifecycleStage' containing constants that represent different stages in the lifecycle of an Orleans client or silo.

classes.name: ServiceLifecycleStage
classes.description: A static class containing constants for various lifecycle stages of Orleans services.

methods.name: First
methods.description: Constant representing the first valid stage in the service's lifecycle.

methods.name: RuntimeInitialize
methods.description: Constant representing the stage where the runtime is initialized.

methods.name: RuntimeServices
methods.description: Constant representing the stage where runtime services are started.

methods.name: RuntimeStorageServices
methods.description: Constant representing the stage where runtime storage is initialized.

methods.name: RuntimeGrainServices
methods.description: Constant representing the stage where runtime grain services are started.

methods.name: AfterRuntimeGrainServices
methods.description: Constant representing the stage after runtime grain services have started.

methods.name: ApplicationServices
methods.description: Constant representing the stage where application layer services are started.

methods.name: BecomeActive
methods.description: Constant indicating the service will be active after this stage; used mainly by membership oracle and gateway.

methods.name: Active
methods.description: Constant indicating the service is active.

methods.name: Last
methods.description: Constant representing the last valid stage in the service's lifecycle.
